Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The bidder shall submit an OEM Technical Compliance Certificate clearly mentioning the exact quoted m ake and model.A valid Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) specific to this bid shall be submitted 2.The bidder shall submit a valid and updated UDYAM Registration Certificate issued by the Government of India.

3.The bidder shall provide comprehensive Onsite Warranty support for a minimum period of 3 years from t he date of installation. 4.The bidder shall have successfully executed similar supply orders for Government Departments, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies during the last five years. Copies of Contract and Completion Certificates shall be uplo aded. 5.The supplier shall attend complaints within 4 hours and rectify faults within 24 hours. If unresolved, an e quivalent or higher configuration standby system shall be provided at no extra cost until restoration. A sig ned undertaking shall be submitted along with the bid. 6.The bidder shall submit audited Financial Statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account, and Auditor' s Report) along with the corresponding Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for the Financial Years , 2022–23, 2023– 24, 2024–25, and 2025–26. Provisional or unaudited financial statements shall not be accepted. 7.The system shall be supplied with a genuine Microsoft Office Lifetime License, pre-installed and activate d. 8.The bidder shall not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Central Government, State Government, P SU, Autonomous Body, or Government Organization during the last five years. A self-declaration shall be s ubmitted. 9.The purchaser reserves the right to verify any document submitted by the bidder from the issuing author ity or OEM at any stage of the tender process. 10.The bidder shall bear all expenses towards Installation, forwarding, transportation, unloading,testing, d emonstration, and user training shall be carried out by qualified engineers at no additional cost. 11.The quoted model shall not be declared End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-Support (EOS) for a minimum perio d of 3 years from the date of installation. An OEM undertaking shall be submitted. 12.The quoted product shall be brand new, unused, and factory sealed. Refurbished, repaired, recondition ed, or open-box products shall not be accepted. 13.No advance payment shall be made under any circumstances. 100% payment shall be released only aft er successful delivery, installation, commissioning, and submission of a proper GST invoice, duly deducting the buyback value of old/obsolete equipment wherever applicable. 14.The system shall be supplied with a genuine Microsoft Office Lifetime License, pre-installed and activat ed. 15.The bidder shall have a minimum GeM Seller Rating of 4.5 or above as on the last date of bid submissio n. 16.Submission of forged, fabricated, altered, or misleading documents shall result in immediate rejection o f the bid and suitable legal action as deemed fit by the purchaser. .
